tlabel: Accounts Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Purchase
doc: Amount of increase from purchase of accounts receivable.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Sale
doc: Amount of decrease from sale of accounts receivable.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Sale, Finance Charge
doc: Accounts Receivable, Sale, Finance Charge

tlabel: Accrued Liabilities, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable, pertaining to costs that are statutory in nature, are incurred on contractual obligations, or accumulate over time and for which invoices have not yet been received or will not be rendered. Examples include taxes, interest, rent and utilities. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

tlabel: Additional Paid in Capital, Common Stock
doc: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital in excess of par, capital surplus, or paid-in capital.

tlabel: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition
doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Expense
doc: Amount of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount capitalized.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as current.

tlabel: Assets
doc: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

tlabel: Assets, Current
doc: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.

tlabel: Cash
doc: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Including Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect and Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change and including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: Commitments and Contingencies
doc: Represents the caption on the face of the balance sheet to indicate that the entity has entered into (1) purchase or supply arrangements that will require expending a portion of its resources to meet the terms thereof, and (2) is exposed to potential losses or, less frequently, gains, arising from (a) possible claims against a company's resources due to future performance under contract terms, and (b) possible losses or likely gains from uncertainties that will ultimately be resolved when one or more future events that are deemed likely to occur do occur or fail to occur.

tlabel: Common Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
doc: Face amount or stated value per share of common stock.

tlabel: Common Stock, Shares Authorized
doc: The maximum number of common shares permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

tlabel: Common Stock, Shares, Issued
doc: Total number of common shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders (includes common shares that were issued, repurchased and remain in the treasury). These shares represent capital invested by the firm's shareholders and owners, and may be all or only a portion of the number of shares authorized. Shares issued include shares outstanding and shares held in the treasury.

tlabel: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
doc: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

tlabel: Common Stock, Value, Issued
doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer, when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

tlabel: Costs and Expenses
doc: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Covenant, Leverage Ratio
doc: Debt Instrument, Covenant, Leverage Ratio

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Face Amount
doc: Face (par) amount of debt instrument at time of issuance.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage
doc: Contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

tlabel: Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate
doc: Weighted average interest rate of debt outstanding.

tlabel: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
doc: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

tlabel: Liability, Defined Benefit Pension Plan
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension plan. Excludes other postretirement benefit plan.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Prior Service Cost (Credit)
doc: Amount of prior service cost (credit) recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Discount Rate
doc: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Rate of Compensation Increase
doc: Weighted average rate increase of compensation, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Discount Rate
doc: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Expected Long-Term Rate of Return on Plan Assets
doc: Weighted average rate of return on plan assets, reflecting average rate of earnings expected on existing plan assets and expected contributions, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost Interest Crediting Rate
doc: Defined Benefit Plan Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost Interest Crediting Rate

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation
doc: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Employer
doc: Amount of contribution received by defined benefit plan from employer which increases plan assets.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Return (Loss) on Plan Assets
doc: Amount of expected return (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit, calculated based on expected long-term rate of return and market-related value of plan assets of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Amount
doc: Amount of asset segregated and restricted to provide benefit under defined benefit plan. Asset includes, but is not limited to, stock, bond, other investment, earning from investment, and contribution by employer and employee.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Funded (Unfunded) Status of Plan
doc: Amount of funded (unfunded) status of defined benefit plan, measured as difference between fair value of plan assets and benefit obligation. Includes, but is not limited to, overfunded (underfunded) status.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Interest Cost
doc: Amount of cost recognized for passage of time related to defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit)
doc: Amount of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Other Cost (Credit)
doc: Amount of defined benefit plan cost (credit), classified as other.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Service Cost
doc: Amount of cost for actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Defined Contribution Plan, Cost
doc: Amount of cost for defined contribution plan.

tlabel: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
doc: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

tlabel: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
doc: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

tlabel: Earnings Per Share, Basic
doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Including Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: Employee-related Liabilities, Current
doc: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
doc: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

tlabel: Environmental Matters Threshold Contingencies
doc: Environmental Matters Threshold Contingencies

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Due after Year Four
doc: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Due after Year Four

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

tlabel: General Insurance Expense
doc: The expense in the period incurred with respect to protection provided by insurance entities against risks other than risks associated with production (which are allocated to cost of sales).

tlabel: Goodwill
doc: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Income Tax Paid, before Refund Received
doc: Amount, before refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

tlabel: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) In Account Payable, Due To Parent
doc: Increase (Decrease) In Account Payable, Due To Parent

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Other Operating Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligations incurred but not paid, and operating obligations classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in current assets classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets after deduction of operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due within one year (or one operating cycle) from all parties, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Share-Based Payment Arrangements
doc: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Nonoperating
doc: Amount of interest expense classified as nonoperating.

tlabel: Interest Income (Expense), Nonoperating
doc: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as nonoperating.

tlabel: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activity
doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

tlabel: Investment Income, Interest
doc: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Labor and Related Expense
doc: Amount of expense for salary, wage, profit sharing; incentive and equity-based compensation; and other employee benefit.

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease And Finance Lease, Liability
doc: Operating lease and finance lease liability.

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease And Finance Lease, Liability, To Be Paid, After Year Four
doc: Lessee operating lease and finance lease liability payments due after year five.

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease And Finance Lease, Liability, To Be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
doc: Lessee, Operating Lease And Finance Lease, Liability, To Be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease And Finance Lease, Liability, To Be Paid, Year Four
doc: Lessee operating lease and finance lease liability payments due year four.

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease And Finance Lease, Liability, To Be Paid, Year One
doc: Lessee, Operating Lease And Finance Lease, Liability, To Be Paid, Year One

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease And Finance Lease, Liability, To Be Paid, Year Three
doc: Lessee, Operating Lease And Finance Lease, Liability, To Be Paid, Year Three

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease And Finance Lease, Liability, To Be Paid, Year Two
doc: Lessee operating lease and finance lease liability payments due year two.

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease And Financing Lease, Liability, To Be Paid
doc: Lessee operating lease and finance lease liability payments due.

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease And Financing Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
doc: Lessee operating lease and finance lease liability undiscounted excess amount.

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease having initial or remaining lease term in excess of one year to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Due after Year Four
doc: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Due after Year Four

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

tlabel: Liabilities and Equity
doc: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

tlabel: Liabilities, Current
doc: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Borrowing Capacity
doc: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

tlabel: Long-Term Debt
doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

tlabel: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation
doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current
doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

tlabel: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation, Including Current Maturities
doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, including portion classified as current.

tlabel: Long-Term Debt, Fair Value
doc: The fair value amount of long-term debt whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

tlabel: Nonoperating Income (Expense)
doc: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

tlabel: Number of Reportable Segments
doc: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

tlabel: Operating And Nonoperating Expense
doc: Operating And Nonoperating Expense

tlabel: Operating Income (Loss)
doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Liability
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
doc: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

tlabel: Other Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

tlabel: Other Cost and Expense, Operating
doc: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

tlabel: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Long Term Assets Noncurrent Excluding Property And Equipment
doc: Other Long Term Assets Noncurrent Excluding Property And Equipment

tlabel: Other Noncash Income (Expense)
doc: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

tlabel: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
doc: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
doc: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

tlabel: Payments To Parent, Financing Activities
doc: Payments To Parent, Financing Activities

tlabel: Payments To Parent, Net, Financing Activities
doc: Payments To Parent, Net, Financing Activities

tlabel: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current
doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock
doc: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

tlabel: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation and amortization from plant, property, and equipment and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

tlabel: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
doc: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

tlabel: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
doc: Amount, before accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

tlabel: Purchased Transportation Costs
doc: Purchased Transportation Costs

tlabel: Purchased Transportation Costs, Direct Operational Shipping
doc: Purchased Transportation Costs, Direct Operational Shipping

tlabel: Receivables, Due From Parent
doc: Receivables, Due From Parent

tlabel: Receivables, Net, Current
doc: The total amount due to the entity within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from outside sources, including trade accounts receivable, notes and loans receivable, as well as any other types of receivables, net of allowances established for the purpose of reducing such receivables to an amount that approximates their net realizable value.

tlabel: Rentals
doc: Rentals

tlabel: Repayment of Long-Term Debt, Long-Term Lease Obligation, and Capital Security
doc: Amount of cash outflow for debt, mandatory redeemable security, and principal payment for finance lease obligation.

tlabel: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

tlabel: Retained Ownership Interest Percentage, After Spin-Off
doc: Retained Ownership Interest Percentage, After Spin-Off

tlabel: Revenue Adjustments, Prior To Termination Of Factoring Agreement
doc: Revenue Adjustments, Prior To Termination Of Factoring Agreement

tlabel: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
doc: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

tlabel: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Finance Lease Liability
doc: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for finance lease liability.

tlabel: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
doc: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

tlabel: Self Insurance Reserve, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount of accrued known and estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property that are expected to be paid after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

tlabel: Separation And Other Costs
doc: Separation And Other Costs

tlabel: Separation And Other Costs, Net Of Payments
doc: Separation And Other Costs, Net Of Payments

tlabel: Separation Transaction, Common Stock, Subscription Receivable
doc: Separation Transaction, Common Stock, Subscription Receivable

tlabel: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
doc: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period
doc: The number of grants made during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

tlabel: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
doc: Per share or unit weighted-average fair value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

tlabel: Equity, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Incorporation, Number Of Shares Issued
doc: Stockholders' Equity, Incorporation, Number Of Shares Issued

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Incorporation, Number Of Shares Outstanding

tlabel: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
doc: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

tlabel: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
doc: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

tlabel: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
doc: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

tlabel: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
doc: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

tlabel: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation
doc: Amount of unrecorded obligation to transfer funds in future for fixed or minimum amount or quantity of product and service at fixed or minimum price. Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced and take-or-pay and throughput contracts.

tlabel: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
doc: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

tlabel: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
doc: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

tlabel: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
doc: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.
